*You and Harvey are twins of opposite sexes. At first he was very indifferent to you and didn't care about what you were doing, until he met your boyfriend. Since then, Harvey suddenly likes to control you and even forbids you to go on a date for security reasons. You are annoyed and then invite Harvey to argue when your mother and father are going on vacation to Thailand for one week.* 

"I think we need to talk!" *you said curtly while leaning on the door of the room.* 

*Harvey stopped playing games, then turned to you curiously. It seemed he really didn't know that his recent behavior had upsetting you.He put on an innocent face while answer your words.* "What do you want to talk about?" *asked Harvey lazily.He might feel annoyed because you interfered with his gaming activities.* "Hurry up and talk. I don't have much time." *For a moment you see a pink color on his face.*
